_comment: Challenge-2A LANDING mission (NAV-8), profile 'real' (3 HULA drones via pyhulax). Each drone: takeoff (HOLD airborne) -> navigate to its OWN valid pad avoiding the inflated crates -> land_on_pad (visual servo onto the green/valid ArUco pad). DECONFLICTION = TIME + SPACE, NEVER altitude bands: the ~1.1 m ceiling + no-overfly rule make altitude-band separation ILLEGAL. (1) TIME: the SafetyController launch-corridor slot serializes takeoff (one drone in the C2 zone at a time) and the landing slot serializes descent (one drone over the pads at a time) — both bounded waits (launch_slot_wait_s / slot_wait_s), never infinite. (2) SPACE: each drone gets a distinct advisory sector_deg wedge from C2 toward its pad (ADVISORY-only SectorGuard over the dead-reckoned estimate; never a control input). Bands are deliberately ABSENT — the bench/real multi-drone separation guard accepts sector_deg on every drone INSTEAD of distinct bands (config.py). arena_name 'sample' supplies the keep-outs + the C2 launch frame the planner needs; it is the SAMPLE map (test/dry-run geometry, still carries the red/decoy pads the valid/invalid guards exercise) — the COMMITTED default so the full suite stays green. ORIGIN-CAL ships finals/configs/arenas/cage.json: the REAL corner-origin cage (~11.3 x 5.3 m, ALL pads valid post-simplification, the heading_offset_deg knob). At gate D, switch arena_name 'sample' -> 'cage' and run finals/tools/calibrate_origin.py to regenerate cage.json from the measured dims + corner origin + launch + chosen pad coords AND set heading_offset_deg from the boot-yaw reading (see finals/docs/origin_calibration.md; tune config, not code). NOTE: the post-simplification mission drops valid/invalid pads + per-pad beacons; landing now CENTRES on the YOLO pad blob — each zone below sets servo_on:'pad' + pad_classes:['landing_pad'] (the COMMITTED default). valid_marker_ids per drone are LEGACY PLACEHOLDER ArUco ids, UNUSED in pad mode (kept until the valid/invalid strip follow-up). To fall back to MARKER servo, delete servo_on + pad_classes from a zone. sector_deg per drone are ADVISORY-only wedges sized for the SAMPLE geometry; recompute them for the cage pad bearings (calibrate_origin.py prints them) onsite. command_timeout_s 30 / mission_budget_s 600 are sized for 3 SERIALIZED takeoffs + transits + SERIALIZED visual landings under real-link latency; the budget is a MAX (the orchestrator exits on all-DONE). PAD MODEL (task #9): pipeline.py trains a landing-pad YOLO detector -> models/pad_v1.pt (single class 'landing_pad', val mAP50 0.984 over 121 train / 30 val frames). It is COMMITTED — tracked via a '!models/pad_v1.pt' .gitignore negation (~5.7 MB) — and this config ships detector.backend 'ultralytics' + weights 'models/pad_v1.pt', so the scored landing detects pads with NO --weights flag, on any checkout. backend 'ultralytics' is validated at load by FILE-EXISTENCE + non-COCO-name ONLY (ultralytics/cv2 import lazily inside make_ultralytics_detector at real-run build time, never at config load), so a bare venv with neither installed still LOADS this config and the full suite stays green; the landing e2e proves true pad ACQUIRE by injecting canned YOLO 'landing_pad' sightings (no detector built in-test). Each land_on_pad zone runs servo_on:'pad' over this model's blobs; test_pad_weights_e2e.py decode-checks the real weights through make_ultralytics_detector when ultralytics+cv2 are present. Retrain via pipeline.py and overwrite models/pad_v1.pt (same path = the contract); --weights still overrides at runtime if ever needed.
_comment_degraded: DEGRADED-FLEET FALLBACK: if a drone fails to discover/connect/report telemetry/open video at preflight, DROP it and fly the survivors instead of aborting the whole swarm. min_drones 1 = fly even on a single surviving drone. The casualty is safed (disconnected, video stopped) + logged (drone_dropped, then fleet_degraded); the orchestrator runs only the reduced fleet. Each survivor still flies its OWN pad + advisory sector, so a degraded run scores fewer pads — never zero for one dead aircraft. Set allow_partial_fleet false to restore strict all-or-nothing.

guards._comment: launch_slot_wait_s / slot_wait_s: the bounded staggered-launch + serialized-landing corridor waits — generous (each drone may queue behind the other two's takeoff/descent) but FINITE (a stuck corridor raises FlightTimeout, never hangs). landing_reserve_s 60: MissionClockGuard lands all 60 s before the budget so nobody is still airborne at expiry. geofence_radius_m: advisory keep-in over the arena (dead-reckoned, never acted on).
